messages.subject: Leaflet Shiny MAPID_bounds becomes iterative
parts:
Hello -

leaflet becomes slow on my machine displaying more than 10k of data points on a map. So I thought I would just plot the most important 1000 points on the map. I first filter the points I want to plot by the map extend and then select the top 1000 points based on the variable "TI" in the dataframe p.points2.

p.points <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$mymap_bounds)) {
        return(subset(p.points2(),rank(-TI)<=1000))
    } else {
        bounds <- input$mymap_bounds
        latRng <- range(bounds$north, bounds$south)
        lngRng <- range(bounds$east, bounds$west)
        in.bound.p <- base::subset(p.points2(),
                                      LAT >= latRng[1] & LAT <= latRng[2] &
                                      LON >= lngRng[1] & LON <= lngRng[2])
        return(subset(in.bound.p,rank(-TI)<=1000))
    }
})

Updating this map with 
observeEvent(input$mymap_bounds, {
    leafletProxy("mymap",data = p.points()) %>% clearMarkers()  %>% addCircleMarkers(~LON, ~LAT, layerId=~ITEMID,fillOpacity=0.6, color="black", fillColor=~COL)
})

now creates an interesting iterative behavior. It 1) first zooms to the new map extent, then 2) filters my data, then 3) adjusts the map extent based on the filtered data, and then goes back to 1). This happens about 3 times before it is stable. Has anybody thought about how to solve this?

Thanks,
D.

messages.subject: Re: Leaflet Shiny MAPID_bounds becomes iterative
parts:
solved the problem by changing to eventReactive(input$mymap_bounds,{...})
instead of p.points <- reactive({...})
That way the sub-setting of the data only happens once, since the map bounds only change once.
